subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith nods in response to the wager offer.
source_quote: Sarith nods.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes that the speaker seems confident they will escape and live.
source_quote: Zalthir says, “You seem to be confident we will escape and live.”

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum asks where they will find safety.
source_quote: Gyrgum asks, “Where will we find safety?”

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth states that there is not enough resources or space for anyone in the Underdark.
source_quote: Eldeth laughs, “Safety? This is the Underdark.  There is not enough resources or space for anyone.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth says survival in the Underdark depends on wits.
source_quote: Survival depends on your wits.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth says people in the Underdark distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.
source_quote: People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin remembers that their stuff is in the chest in Ilvara’s room.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes the Drow leader keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says if any other Drow had their stuff, they would taunt them.
source_quote: And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin turns to the Drow and says their deal is accepted.
source_quote: The dwarf turns to the Drow and says, “Your deal is accepted. When?”

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is the Drow leader who keeps loot in her room.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.

subject: Ilvara’s room
fact: Ilvara’s room contains a chest where the prisoners’ stuff is stored.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: chest
fact: The chest is located in Ilvara’s room and contains the prisoners’ belongings.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: accepting the deal
fact: The Drow accept Thorin’s deal to collect the wager after a long rest.
source_quote: “After a long rest, before you go on your assigned tasks.”

subject: sleep in slave pen
fact: Everyone sleeps in the slave pen with troubled and fitful sleep.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images.

subject: dark shadows
fact: Dark shadows move and reach out toward prisoners during their nightmares in the slave pen.
source_quote: Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them

subject: oily tentacles
fact: Oily tentacles slide and brush against prisoners during their nightmares in the slave pen.
source_quote: Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them

subject: great buzzing and howling
fact: A great buzzing and howling rises in the distance during prisoners’ nightmares in the slave pen.
source_quote: a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance.

subject: suppurating wounds
fact: Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects during prisoners’ nightmares in the slave pen.
source_quote: Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wakes up and remembers Sethir mentioned a grey ooze in the pool.
source_quote: Daz wakes up and remembers, “Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir is referenced as having mentioned a grey ooze in the pool.
source_quote: Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool.

subject: grey ooze
fact: A grey ooze exists in the pool and is used to process waste.
source_quote: Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.

subject: wager
fact: A wager is made about escaping and living, to be collected after a long rest.
source_quote: “Wanna bet?”

subject: wager
fact: The wager will be collected after a long rest, before assigned tasks.
source_quote: “After a long rest, before you go on your assigned tasks.”
